programs.title: A Working Man
programs.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programs.title: You Gotta Believe
programs.desc: A group of baseball players are having the most important season of their lives.For one of the boys, the stakes are even higher - the team fights not only for victories, but also for his father's dream to come true.

programs.title: Batman Azteca: Choque de Imperios
programs.desc: Times of the Aztec Empire.The village leader, Toltecatzin, is murdered by the conquistadors.His son, Yohualli Coatl, flees to Tenochtitlán to warn King Moctezuma and his high priest Yoka.

programs.title: Kung Fu Panda: Secrets of the Masters
programs.desc: Po and the Mighty Five - Tigress, Monkey, Viper, Crane and Mantis - discover a legend related to three kung-fu masters: Flying Master Rhino, Ox and Crocodile.

programs.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
programs.desc: The demonic Voldemort spreads terror in the wizarding world.The situation is made worse by the fact that in his hands he finds the Elder Wand, which was extracted from Dumbledore's grave.Harry Potter and his faithful friends Ron and Hermione continue their search for horcruxes - mysterious objects in which the Dark Lord hid parts of his soul.Two more remain - Rowena Ravenclaw's diadem and Nagini's snake.Their destruction will make Voldemort no longer immortal.The young wizards want to find them as quickly as possible.To get the diadem, they must return to Hogwarts, which is now ruled by Severus Snape.The director manages to escape.Professor McGonagall prepares teachers and students to defend the school against Death Eaters.Many people die during fierce fighting.Harry wants to destroy the last Horcrux.He learns about the past of his hated teacher and the motives behind his actions.He discovers that this is not the end of his mission.He goes to the Forbidden Forest to meet Voldemort..

programs.title: Maid in Manhattan
programs.desc: New York.Divorcee Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez) raises her son alone.She works as a maid at the luxurious Beresford Hotel in Manhattan.While cleaning the apartment of aristocrat Caroline Lane (Natasha Richardson), the woman tries on her elegant outfit, in which she looks exceptionally nice.Another hotel guest sees her so changed.He is lawyer Christopher Matthew (Ralph Fiennes), running for parliament.He takes Marisa as a person of a similar social status to himself.They go for a walk together and then eat dinner together.The woman cannot bring herself to correct the mistake, especially since she likes Christopher.However, it is not known how the future senator will react to the fact that his chosen one is an ordinary girl from the Bronx... The luxurious Beresford hotel, where the main character of the film works, is in fact the famous Waldorf-Astoria on Park Avenue.
